newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TAKE PART IN PENSION SAVINGS, BELGIAN CERA ADVISES.
newsitem.headline: TAKE PART IN PENSION SAVINGS, BELGIAN CERA ADVISES.

text.p: Belgian CERA bank on Thursday urged Belgians to take part in pension savings, saying it gave an annual fiscal benefit of 7,500 francs per person on average.
CERA said in a report that 4.6 million active Belgians -- 75 percent -- did not make regular pension savings, effectively offering the state a present of 35 billion francs annually.

The report showed that the savings fund market had doubled in the past five years. It said the average pension saver was between 40 and 60 years but that young people had more confidence in a life insurance. -- +32 2 287 6815.
